generic.Defined scope/population: All out-of-town directors confirmed attending the multi-day board session.
generic.In-scope period: The multi-day board session dates plus surrounding travel days.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Hotel booking, dinner reservation, and dietary restrictions captured per director.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Room and dinner headcount matches the confirmed attendee list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Confirmations filed with booking date and reservation number in the logistics folder.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any unavailable hotel or dietary conflict logged with the alternative arranged.
generic.Test population: Every out-of-town director on the multi-day agenda.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires a filed confirmation for each out-of-town director with no gaps.
generic.Exception handling path: Booking or dietary issues escalate to the Governance Analyst for same-day resolution.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Hotel, dinner, and itinerary confirmed and filed before the session start date.

steps.title: Pull the out-of-town director list from the board portal roster

Filter to directors whose home address is outside the meeting city.

verify: Compare the filtered list count to the RSVP roster count in the portal.
Pass when every out-of-town director on the roster appears on the list.

steps.title: Book hotel accommodations for each out-of-town director
sop: Reserve a room block with the host hotel for the session dates.
Assign each director a room at the rate set by the travel policy.
Done when a hotel confirmation number exists for every out-of-town director.
verify: Check the hotel confirmation against the out-of-town director list.
Pass when a confirmation number is on file for each director.

steps.title: Collect dietary restrictions and book the director dinner
sop: Send a dietary-restriction request to each attending director.
Book a dinner venue that can accommodate every disclosed restriction.
Done when the dinner reservation and dietary list are both confirmed.
verify: Check the dinner headcount against the dietary-restriction log.
Pass when the two counts match with no outstanding response.

steps.title: File the hotel and dinner confirmations in the logistics folder
sop: Save the hotel and dinner confirmation documents to the SharePoint logistics folder.
Name each file with the director name and confirmation date.
Done when both confirmations are filed for every out-of-town director.
verify: Open the logistics folder and check filenames against the director list.
Pass when every director has both a hotel and dinner file present.

steps.title: Draft and send the personalized itinerary through the board portal
sop: Populate the itinerary template with hotel, dinner, and timing details per director.
Send the itinerary to each director as a board portal message.
Done when every out-of-town director has received their itinerary.
verify: Check the board portal delivery log for each director's itinerary.
Pass when delivery status shows received for all out-of-town directors.

steps.title: Reconcile logistics completion ahead of the session start
sop: Review the logistics folder against the out-of-town director list.
Resolve any missing hotel, dinner, or itinerary item before the start date.
Done when no gaps remain across hotel, dinner, and itinerary items.
verify: Reconcile the final checklist against the director list.
Pass when all three items are confirmed for every out-of-town director.

Done when the bridge booking and dial-in credentials are confirmed.

Pass when the test call connects successfully.

steps.title: Send technology test invitations to virtual directors
sop: Draft a test-call invitation with the bridge link and dial-in codes.
Send the invitation at least two days ahead to each virtual director.
Done when every virtual director has received the test invitation.
verify: Check the board portal or email delivery log for each invitation.
Pass when all virtual directors show a delivered invitation.

sop: Host a dry-run test call with each director joining virtually.
Confirm audio, video, and live-voting access for each participant.

verify: Check the dry-run attendance log against the virtual director list.
Pass when every virtual director completed the test without issue.

steps.title: Confirm final technology readiness before the meeting opens

Resolve any last-minute connectivity or equipment issue.

verify: Review the final readiness checklist against each component.
Pass when bridge, AV, and live-voting all show ready status.

steps.title: File the executed proxy instrument in the minute book

Done when the proxy instrument is filed alongside the meeting minutes.

steps.title: Confirm the proxy is counted correctly toward quorum
sop: Cross-check the logged proxy against the quorum calculation for the meeting.

Done when the proxy's quorum and voting effect are confirmed.

Pass when the proxy is reflected consistently in both records.

steps.title: Reconcile all proxy appointments before the meeting opens

verify: Reconcile the proxy log against the final attendance list.
Pass when every proxy-represented director has a compliant filed form.

verify: Scan the draft for any item missing a presenter or action tag.
Pass when all items carry both fields.

steps.title: Circulate the draft agenda to the board chair for approval
sop: Send the draft agenda to the board chair via the board portal.
Request approval or edits before the portal upload deadline.
Done when the chair returns approval or final edits.
verify: Check the portal message thread for the chair's approval reply.
Pass when the chair's approval is confirmed before the deadline.

steps.title: Incorporate chair edits and finalize the draft
sop: Apply any edits the chair requested to the draft agenda.
Confirm the revised version reflects all chair feedback.
Done when the final draft matches the chair's approved edits.
verify: Compare the final draft against the chair's tracked edits.
Pass when every requested edit is reflected.

steps.title: Confirm the finalized agenda maps to the work plan before upload
sop: Compare the finalized agenda item-by-item against the work plan tracker.
Confirm no due item was dropped without a logged reason.
Done when the agenda-to-work-plan mapping is confirmed one-to-one.
verify: Reconcile the finalized agenda against the tracker's due-item list.
Pass when every due item is mapped or logged as deferred with reason.

generic.Defined scope/population: All directors with an RSVP status recorded for this meeting.

steps.title: Cross-check RSVP responses against the bylaws quorum threshold

Compare the responding director count against the bylaws quorum threshold.

Pass when the count and threshold comparison is accurate.

steps.title: Confirm the attendance mode for each responding director

steps.title: Flag any quorum shortfall to the Corporate Secretary

Notify the Corporate Secretary at least three business days before the meeting.

verify: Check the notification timestamp against the three-business-day window.
Pass when the flag, if needed, was sent within the window.

steps.title: Update the quorum tracker as responses are received
sop: Update the tracker each time a new RSVP or proxy is received.

Done when the tracker reflects the latest response status.
verify: Review the tracker's last-updated timestamp against the latest RSVP.
Pass when the tracker is current as of the latest response.

steps.title: Corporate Secretary reviews the quorum determination
sop: Review the quorum tracker and attendance modes ahead of the meeting.
Confirm the shortfall flag, if any, was addressed or escalated.
Done when the Corporate Secretary confirms the quorum determination.
verify: Check the tracker for the Corporate Secretary's review sign-off.
Pass when the determination is confirmed as accurate.

steps.title: Finalize the quorum confirmation before the meeting opens
sop: Lock the quorum tracker once all RSVPs are received or the meeting starts.
Confirm the final count is at or above the bylaws threshold.
Done when the final quorum status is locked and confirmed.
verify: Reconcile the locked tracker count against the threshold.
Pass when the confirmed count meets or exceeds quorum.

Done when every virtual director has completed a successful dry run.

Done when the checklist reflects a result for every virtual director.

sop: Identify any director or component that failed the readiness test.

sop: Review the completed checklist one final time before start.
Confirm no outstanding failure remains unresolved.
Done when readiness is confirmed for all virtual and hybrid participants.

steps.title: Confirm all travel arrangements are complete before departure

Resolve any missing flight, transport, or itinerary item.
